items.difficulty_reason: A set of monomorphisms that detects dg-injective objects: takes T and M_t -> M'_t from the graded-injective characterisation and S, M_s from the small-acyclics lemma, produces an acyclic extension homotopic to zero by taking the cone on the identity (with the extra observation that the identity on that cone is null-homotopic), then runs a transfinite construction and applies Homology, ML-over-ordinals to get the required factorisation. Retained author proof at lines 4085-4181.
